criteria.instruction: Give a readable summary rather than a raw link or token dump, name at least eight distinct stories from the 30-item front-page snapshot, and do not claim that any linked target was opened or read.
Use at least eight distinct page_link citation tokens from the supplied story mapping.

Every distinct story specifically named in the answer must have its corresponding page_link token somewhere in the answer, normally at its first substantive mention. Repeating an already cited story later does not require repeating its token. Never attach one story’s token to another story.

The Hacker News homepage token [[web:b31aaefc-f2b5-45c5-a03a-62798554f2f6]] may support an aggregate claim about the page’s overall composition, but it must not be the only reference for any named story and must not replace that story’s page_link token elsewhere in the answer.
